title: Abu Dhabi’s G42 Weighs US Ownership to Safeguard AI Chip Access
summary: Executives at Abu Dhabi-based artificial intelligence firm G42 have held exploratory talks over potentially selling a majority stake to American companies, people familiar with the matter said, as it races to guarantee access to high-tech chips beyond next year.

title: Middle East’s Data Center Push Endures Under the Cloud of War
summary: The Persian Gulf’s richest states are pushing forward with plans for a massive build-out of artificial intelligence infrastructure, even though data centers have become repeated targets in the US war with Iran.

title: AMC Boss Slams Robinhood, Calls Stock Token ‘Quasi-Fake’
summary: AMC Entertainment Holdings Inc. boss Adam Aron criticized Robinhood Markets Inc. after the platform launched a tokenized version of the theater chain’s shares, escalating a debate over synthetic equities as Wall Street pushes toward always-on markets.

title: What to Expect at Sept. 9 Apple Event: Foldable iPhone, iPhone 18 Pro, Watch
summary: From the foldable iPhone to a touch-screen MacBook, here’s what to expect on Sept. 9 and beyond.

title: China’s Moonshot Said to Seek Up to $5 Billion in Hong Kong IPO This Year
summary: Moonshot AI is considering raising up to $5 billion in its planned Hong Kong initial public offering as soon as this year, people familiar with the matter said, as the Chinese artificial intelligence champion taps into strong investor demand.

title: Amazon Fight Over Ad Fees Is Latest Clash With FTC
summary: FTC says the e-commerce company overcharged advertisers by $20 billion

title: Wayve Autonomous Taxi Rides Debut on Uber in London
summary: Autonomous rides with hands still hovering over the steering wheel

title: DeepSeek Plans to Deploy Huawei AI Chips for New Data Center
summary: DeepSeek plans to power a massive data center it’s building in Inner Mongolia with at least 160,000 of Huawei Technologies Co.’s top accelerators. Neil Campling reports on Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: DeepSeek Plans Big Huawei AI Chip Order to Power New Data Center
summary: DeepSeek plans to deploy at least 160,000 of Huawei Technologies Co.’s top accelerators at a massive data center it’s building in Inner Mongolia, which could create one of the largest known clusters of Huawei AI chips and advance China’s efforts to replace Nvidia Corp.

title: Roubini Says He's Not Concerned About an AI Bubble
summary: Nouriel Roubini, CEO of Roubini Macro Associates, discusses the outlook for bond markets, the artificial intelligence trade and risks facing markets. "Some people are concerned about this AI being a bubble. That's not my view," Roubini tells Bloomberg's France Lacqua in Cernobbio, Italy. "I think it is a secular increase in capex and potential growth, but some corrections could occur." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Capcom, Kokusai Electric and JX Metals to Join Nikkei 225 Index
summary: Video game developer Capcom Co. and chip gear maker Kokusai Electric Corp are set to join Japan’s Nikkei 225 Stock Average from Oct. 1, according to index provider Nikkei Inc.

title: India Space Surveillance Gets Boost With GSLV Launch Success
summary: India’s space program notched a successful rocket launch on Friday, placing an Earth-observation craft into orbit as New Delhi works to sharpen its satellite-based surveillance capabilities.

title: SoftBank’s ¥1 Trillion Retail Bond Rejuvenates Japan Debt Market
summary: SoftBank Group Corp. priced a ¥1 trillion ($6.3 billion) retail bond in an offering that expands Japan’s retail corporate debt market and gives investors a viable alternative to bank deposits and stocks.

title: Thailand Puts 49 Data Centers on Hold Over Resource Strain
summary: Thailand’s embrace of data centers hit a speed bump after the government suspended construction of 49 server farms as public concerns about the power-hungry facilities’ impact on communities intensify.

title: Korea’s Memory Chip Lead Over China Set to Grow, Report Says
summary: South Korea’s lead over China in memory chip production is expected to widen further thanks to an aggressive expansion of domestic facilities by Samsung Electronics Co. and SK Hynix Inc., according to the Bank of Korea.

title: Anthropic Finalizing $15 Billion Pre-IPO Credit Facility
summary: Anthropic PBC is set to finalize an expansion of its revolving credit facility to $15 billion, according to people familiar with the matter, ahead of the firm's public filing for its initial public offering. The maker of the Claude chatbot is seeking to raise as much as SpaceX or more in the IPO, people familiar with the preparations said. Morgan Stanley is leading the process, the people said. Bloomberg's Anthony Stephens reports. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Oura CMO on Ring-Maker's Demographic Appeal, Cost
summary: Oura's Chief Medical Officer Dr Ricky Bloomfield says their ring will help detect diseases, as the company files for an initial public offering, showing soaring revenue as well as increasing losses. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Novo Owner to Build $62 Million Quantum Chip Plant in Denmark
summary: The foundation that controls Ozempic maker Novo Nordisk A/S is building a new quantum chip factory in Copenhagen as the global race to develop the emerging technology heats up.

title: India Launches Rocket in Boost to Space Ambitions
summary: India’s space program notched a much-needed success with a rocket launch on Friday, after two consecutive failures of another launcher that had long served as its workhorse rocket. Bloomberg's Mihir Mishra reports. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Andreessen-Backed AI Startup Gimlet Is Valued at $3 Billion in New Round
summary: The company, which helps divide AI tasks among different chips, raised $300 million in its latest round
